messages.subject: sdreport() and as.list(...)
parts: I have been saving TMB model results for further processing with python scripts. To do so, I call on the python pyreadr package that will read R data data.frames saved to .RData files using save(...). It worked quite well until I started to add objects returned from sdreport(obj). I managed a workaround, but I cannot understand why there is a problem. It is reproducible. See https://github.com/ofajardo/pyreadr/issues/36 for further information.
